about: The first-time tips (tip.<id>); when each comes up is game data (content/game-v1/game/tips.json).

strings.tip.look: Move the mouse to look around. The valley below is where you are headed.
strings.tip.walk: Walk with W A S D. The trail starts at your feet and leads down the mountain.
strings.tip.jump: Press Space to jump up a ledge or over a gap.
strings.tip.note: A note lies on the ledge: “Welcome, traveler. My camp is down the trail, past the trees. Follow the camino (the trail) and come and say hello. {npc:guide}”
strings.tip.gather: Aim the dot in the middle of the screen at a tree trunk and hold the left mouse button to collect wood.
strings.tip.pickup: What you collect appears in the bar at the bottom. Press {key:inventory} to see everything you carry.
strings.tip.npc: Press {key:talk} to talk to someone. The English under the Spanish is there to help you.
strings.tip.speak: Hold {key:listen} (or {key:listenAlt}) to speak, or press W to type. Press H for help any time. Nothing here is a test: if you are not sure, press N for “I don't know”.
strings.tip.objective: The list at the top right shows what the camp needs. The English next to each word goes away once you know the word.
strings.tip.needs: Hunger, thirst and sleep go down as you walk and work. Eat berries or bread, drink water from the river or your bottle, and sleep in a bed at the inn (la posada) or by a lit fire when you are tired.
strings.tip.collapse: You were too tired to go on, so you fell asleep where you stood. A day has passed. Sleep in a bed or by a lit fire before you are worn out to wake up rested.
